note: Code shape reference; commands illustrative only, not directly runnable in inventory seed.

patterns.title: One Python stdlib command with testable pure functions
patterns.when: Small offline processing or numerical baseline; output files or JSON

patterns.title: SQLite normalized tables or FTS5
patterns.when: Joins, provenance and local keyword search
patterns.gates: Dataset fits in single file and local filesystem available

patterns.title: Tabular analytics using pandas or DuckDB
patterns.gates: Libraries installed and join grain verified

patterns.title: Vanilla HTML/JS + Node.js HTTP
patterns.when: Small frontend plus simple local API
patterns.gates: Task does not need specialized Python numerics

patterns.title: Python calculation/API + JS browser UI
patterns.when: UI needs repeated numerical or backend calculations
patterns.gates: Both runtimes available; API schema agreed

patterns.title: Existing React/TS app, preserve installed stack
patterns.when: Existing project uses React or frontend complexity justifies
patterns.command_illustrative: npm run test && npm run dev

patterns.title: Graph algorithms using Python stdlib
patterns.gates: Problem actually is graph model; weights verified

patterns.title: Feasible heuristic + independent verifier
patterns.gates: Hard constraints can be checked explicitly
patterns.checks: All constraints, baseline objective, small oracle

patterns.title: OR-Tools routing/CP-SAT/min-cost flow
patterns.when: Structure matches solver and package available
patterns.checks: Infeasible vs feasible vs OPTIMAL status + raw check

patterns.title: NumPy/SciPy/SymPy scientific core
patterns.when: ODE, linear algebra, symbolic, numeric solve

patterns.title: Baseline and leakage-safe evaluation
patterns.checks: Holdout, split leakage, calibration or residual

patterns.title: Static HTML+CSV/PNG export
patterns.when: Deliverable is readable report with evidence
patterns.checks: Numbers and source trace + visual check

patterns.title: Source offsets + FTS5 index
patterns.gates: Documents have extractable text or justified OCR
patterns.checks: Exact source trace, outdated clause negative

patterns.title: Local stdio MCP wrapper around CLI
patterns.when: Repeated structured invocations benefit from tools
patterns.gates: MCP enabled and tested; no outbound data
